questions.question: A New Testament letter says Jesus deserves more glory than Moses. What picture does the writer use to show this?

answers.text: A builder honored above the house
A shepherd honored above the sheep
A teacher honored above the student

questions.question: Moses was faithful as a servant in God's house. In what way is Christ faithful?

answers.text: As the Son over God's house
As a guest inside God's house
